title: Sharing — send a post or a profile anywhere, with a link that opens it

tasks.title: The share menu for posts and profiles

acs.text: WHEN a viewer presses "Share" on a post (in the timeline or on its page) or on a profile THE SYSTEM SHALL offer, in a small menu, "Copy link", "WhatsApp" and "Email", and "Share…" when the browser offers the Web Share API; the link is the absolute address of `/social/p/$postId` (or `/social/u/$profileId`) on the reader's site, built with `host.href` (R15).
scenarios: AC-001 the share menu and the link it shares

acs.text: WHEN the viewer chooses "Copy link" THE SYSTEM SHALL put the link on the clipboard and say "Link copied" in a polite live region; "WhatsApp" opens `https://wa.me/?text=` with the post's opening words and the link; "Email" opens a `mailto:` with a subject and the link; the menu closes with Escape or a click outside and returns focus to the Share button.
